Hi, I'm Dia.

Welcome to **Dia's Blog**, a space for thoughts on psychology, love, relationships, and life.
I'm a systemic psychotherapist, currently working on my PhD on romantic relationship and sexuality. This blog is where I bring together clinical insight, research, and personal reflection - sharing what I learn and think about along the way.
